name: northwind-policies
description: Questions about the Northwind Labs policy corpus in evaluation/corpus. Relevance is labelled with evidence snippets: a retrieved chunk is relevant when it comes from the named document and contains the evidence text (case- and whitespace-insensitive), so labels survive changes to chunking or the embedding model. expected_facts lists facts a correct answer must state; each fact is a list of accepted phrasings.

questions.question: How many days of paid annual leave do full-time employees get?
questions.expected_answer: Full-time employees receive 20 days of paid annual leave per calendar year.

questions.question: What is the leave policy?
questions.expected_answer: Full-time employees get 20 days of paid annual leave per year (pro-rated for part-time staff); up to 5 unused days can be carried over and must be used by 31 March.

questions.question: How many unused leave days can be carried over, and until when must they be used?
questions.expected_answer: Up to 5 unused days can be carried over, and they must be used by 31 March.

relevant.evidence: Up to 5 unused days may be carried over

questions.question: When is a doctor's note required for sick leave?
questions.expected_answer: For absences of more than three consecutive working days.

relevant.evidence: more than three consecutive working days

questions.question: How long is parental leave for the primary caregiver?
questions.expected_answer: 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave.

relevant.evidence: 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave

questions.question: What are the core collaboration hours?
questions.expected_answer: 10:00 to 16:00 local time.

questions.question: What is the hotel cost limit per night in London?
questions.expected_answer: $275 per night (London is one of the higher-cap cities).

questions.question: What is the daily meal allowance for international travel?
questions.expected_answer: $80 per day.

questions.question: Which tool should I use to book flights and hotels?
questions.expected_answer: TripDesk, the company travel portal.

questions.question: How long do I have to submit an expense report?
questions.expected_answer: Within 30 days of the expense; expenses submitted after 90 days are not reimbursed.

questions.question: What is the minimum password length?
questions.expected_answer: At least 14 characters.

questions.question: Where should I forward a phishing email?
questions.expected_answer: To phishing@northwind.example, without clicking its links.

questions.question: How quickly must a SEV1 incident be acknowledged?
questions.expected_answer: Within 15 minutes, by the on-call engineer.

questions.question: How big is the annual learning budget?
questions.expected_answer: $1,500 per employee per year, for courses, books and conferences.

questions.question: When does health insurance coverage start?
questions.expected_answer: On the first day of the month after your start date.

relevant.evidence: first day of the month after your start date

questions.question: How much does Northwind match for retirement contributions?
questions.expected_answer: Up to 4% of salary, vesting immediately.

questions.question: How much vacation time do I get each year?
questions.expected_answer: 20 days of paid annual leave per year for full-time employees.

questions.question: Am I allowed to work from home?
questions.expected_answer: Yes, up to three days per week with your manager's approval (not during the first 90 days).

relevant.evidence: up to three days per week

questions.question: I only joined last month. Can I already work remotely?
questions.expected_answer: No. Remote work is not available during the first 90 days (the probation period).

relevant.evidence: not available during the first 90 days

questions.question: What should I do if my laptop gets stolen?
questions.expected_answer: Report it to the IT Service Desk within 24 hours.

relevant.evidence: reported to the IT Service Desk within 24 hours

questions.question: Is there any money for a desk chair for my home setup?
questions.expected_answer: Yes, new employees get a one-time $500 home office stipend.

questions.question: Will the company pay for my gym membership?
questions.expected_answer: Yes, through the wellness allowance of $50 per month.

questions.question: Can I claim a glass of wine at dinner on a business trip?
questions.expected_answer: No, alcohol is not reimbursable.

questions.question: What is Keeper?
questions.expected_answer: The company password manager, used to generate and store passwords.

questions.question: What is the EthicsLine?
questions.expected_answer: A channel for reporting concerns anonymously (ethics.northwind.example).

questions.question: What is the response time for a SEV2?
questions.expected_answer: A SEV2 incident must be acknowledged within one hour.

questions.question: I have an 8-hour flight to London. Which class can I book and what is my hotel limit?
questions.expected_answer: Business class is allowed for flights of 6 hours or more with Vice President approval, and the London hotel cap is $275 per night.

relevant.evidence: Business class is allowed for flights of 6 hours or more

questions.question: How many days of paid annual leave and paid sick leave do full-time employees get per year?
questions.expected_answer: 20 days of paid annual leave and 10 days of paid sick leave.

questions.question: What are the four data classification levels, and where must Restricted data never be stored?
questions.expected_answer: Public, Internal, Confidential and Restricted; Restricted data must never be stored on personal devices.

relevant.evidence: never be stored on personal devices

questions.question: Which approvals do I need for a business-class flight, and who approves a $5,000 software purchase?
questions.expected_answer: Business class needs Vice President approval (flights of 6 hours or more); software is bought centrally through the IT Service Desk, and purchases between $1,000 and $10,000 also need the Finance budget owner's approval.

relevant.evidence: with approval from a Vice President

questions.question: What is the stock option vesting schedule?
questions.expected_answer: Not covered by the documents (only retirement matching contributions, which vest immediately, are mentioned).

questions.question: Who is the CEO of Northwind Labs?
questions.expected_answer: Not covered by the documents.

questions.question: Are dogs allowed in the office?
questions.expected_answer: Not covered by the documents.

questions.question: How many days of bereavement leave do employees get?
questions.expected_answer: Not covered by the documents (annual, sick and parental leave are, bereavement leave is not).

questions.question: What is the reimbursement rate for electric scooter rentals?
questions.expected_answer: Not covered by the documents.

questions.question: What is the dress code?
questions.expected_answer: Not covered by the documents.
